reason: V1 static-quality frames were sampled from final videos with burned subtitles while V2 frames were sampled from pre-subtitle scene clips.
Renderer text payload/font-fit semantics were not aligned with LayoutRouter measurement, allowing rendered text overflow to escape fatal clipping metrics.

static_quality_metric.sample: one midpoint frame per pre-subtitle scene clip for BOTH V1 and V2
static_quality_metric.v1_source: retained V1 scenes/<scene_id>.mp4 before VideoAssembler subtitle burn-in
static_quality_metric.v2_source: V2 rendered scene clips before final audio mux
static_quality_metric.aggregate: 100 * weighted mean across all 9 representative scene frames
static_quality_metric.interpretation: deterministic static-composition proxy only; not a human aesthetic score

core_gate_mapping.fatal_clipping_count: sum layout content clipping/frame overflow plus any renderer text-fit failure across 9 scenes
core_gate_mapping.fatal_overlap_count: sum non-semantic bbox collisions across 9 scenes
core_gate_mapping.selective_repair_success_rate: repair cases whose patch changes scene hash and rendered frame digest, repaired render satisfies the same text-fit/layout QA contract, and unrelated scene digests remain identical
core_gate_mapping.reproducibility_rate: lesson repeated run final frame_digest equality / successful lessons
core_gate_mapping.v1_v2_critical_regression_count: count lessons violating frozen V1 required media invariants (video codec, audio stream/codec, resolution, final artifact)
core_gate_mapping.v2_static_quality_delta: V2 static_composition_proxy_v2 - V1 static_composition_proxy_v2 using pre-subtitle scene clips on both sides

repair_cases.selection: one deterministic first-node SET_REGION patch per scene

freeze_rule: After the first VALID v2-core-gate-v2 execution, this specification and metric formula must not change. Fix engine only, then rerun this exact spec.
